title:
IMPLETA SUNT QUAE CONCINIT
 DAVID FIDELI CARMINE
 DICENDO NATIONIBUS
 REGNAVIT A LIGNO DEUS
html_source:
A verse of the aforementioned hymn by Aquinas written for Maundy Thursday. It reads:

What David sang in his faithful song has been fulfilled,
saying to the nations: God reigned from the Tree.

Its full, English hymnal transcription:
That which the prophet-king of old
hath in mysterious verse foretold,
is now accomplished, whilst we see
God ruling the nations from a Tree.
